activity.notes: José de San Martín assumed supreme political and military command of the free departments of Peru under the title Protector on 3 August 1821 and resigned before the Constituent Congress on 20 September 1822. This is a distinct Peruvian governing Activity from his earlier service to the United Provinces of the Río de la Plata.

sources.title: Decreto Supremo N.° 1-1821-RE — Ministerio de Relaciones Exteriores del Perú
sources.citation_text: The decree of 3 August 1821 unites supreme political and military command in San Martín under the title Protector.

sources.title: Presidentes y Gobernantes de la República del Perú — Congreso de la República
sources.citation_text: The Peruvian Congress lists José de San Martín as Protector from 3 August 1821 to 20 September 1822.
